title: 構造設計学
subtitle: Structual Design
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	learn how to estimate deflection of beams and axial forces in trusses.
(2)	learn how to estimate axial force in short columns and buckling loads of long columns.
(3)	learn analysis of statically indeterminate structures.
(4)	learn the slope deflection method.
advice:
This course will cover the following topics:

1. Deflection of beams
2. Axial forces in truss structures
3. Stresses in short columns and the cross-sectional core
4. Buckling of long columns
5. Statically indeterminate structures
6. Rigid frames

In the study of deflection of beams, the second moment of area, bending moment and second-order differential equations are used. In the study of statically indeterminate structures, bending moment and shear force are used. Before taking this course, students are requested to understand Structural Mechanics I and II.
books: 基礎から学ぶ構造力学，藤本一男・西田進・中村一平・本田秀行・木村定雄，森北出版，2005
requiredKnowledge: Understanding of Structural Mechanics I and II.
